name: Sprinto
description: Sprinto is a compliance automation platform that continuously monitors security controls, digitizes 200+ frameworks, and automates evidence collection to help organizations achieve and maintain certifications such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR.
best_for: Startups pursuing their first security certification through mid-size teams running a full GRC program, wanting automated compliance monitoring plus built-in vendor-risk, policy, and AI-governance modules.
features: 25+ frameworks automated out of the box and 200+ frameworks digitized, with continuous monitoring across 300+ integrations
Automated evidence collection, audit planning/management, and access to a vetted auditor network, plus bring-your-own-auditor support
AI-assisted policy drafting and control/policy mapping, with employee policy acknowledgement campaigns
Automated vendor discovery and inventory, with AI-powered vendor security document reviews for third-party risk management
AI-powered security questionnaire automation and a public Trust Center with a custom domain
AI Systems Inventory, AI system reviews, and AI risk assessments for AI governance programs
pros: Digitizes 200+ frameworks with 25+ automated out of the box, covering a wide range of regional and niche frameworks beyond the common SOC 2/ISO set
Bundles vendor risk management, policy management, and AI governance into the same platform as core compliance automation
cons: No published pricing -- both Foundation and Growth plans are quote-based, with add-ons (additional frameworks, professional services, enterprise risk/trust/vendor management) sold separately

Sprinto's own security page describes its infrastructure controls as "aligned with" frameworks like SOC 2 and ISO 27001 -- a separate, narrower claim than Sprinto itself holding those certifications -- see FAQ

tiers.name: Foundation
tiers.notes: "For startups on their first certification." Includes compliance automation, audit management, policy management, personnel compliance, vendor risk management, risk management, and trust management. No public price; requires contacting sales.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: "For teams automating compliance." Everything in Foundation plus programmable monitors, custom workflows/API, bring-your-own-controls, internal audit management, and priority support. No public price; requires contacting sales.

faq.question: Is Sprinto itself SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certified?
faq.answer: That is a separate claim from Sprinto helping customers earn their own certifications. Sprinto's public trust center (trust.sprinto.com) lists Sprinto's own compliance status for ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 42001, and HIPAA as "Compliant." Separately, Sprinto's main security page describes its underlying AWS infrastructure controls as "aligned with SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS Level 1, and FISMA Moderate" -- a narrower claim about infrastructure alignment rather than a blanket certification of the whole company.
